room.north_post.title: North Post
room.north_post.description: A carter's [post](post) where the north road ends. The lane runs south.
room.lane.title: Lane
room.lane.description: A long lane between the two posts, north and south.
room.south_post.title: South Post
room.south_post.description: A carter's [post](post) where the south road ends. The lane runs north.
detail.post.title: Carter's post
detail.north_post.description: A painted board: rides to the South Post, three coins.
detail.south_post.description: A painted board: rides to the North Post, three coins.
npc.carter.description: A carter with a quick cart, who goes only where you have been before.
transport.unaffordable: You need three coins for the ride.
transport.ride_south.used: The carter whips up the horse, and the cart sets you down at the South Post.
transport.ride_north.used: The carter whips up the horse, and the cart sets you down at the North Post.
